messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. Having hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase the risk of miscarriage, high blood pressure in pregnancy, pre-eclampsia, stillbirth, or premature birth, and untreated hypothyroidism can affect the baby's brain development. The benefit of treating hypothyroidism outweighs these risks, and levothyroxine should not be stopped during pregnancy.
Your dose needs are often higher during pregnancy. Your doctor will check your thyroid blood tests as soon as your pregnancy is confirmed and at least once in each trimester, and will usually put you back on your pre-pregnancy dose straight after you give birth, with another blood test 4 to 8 weeks later.
Tell your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Levothyroxine passes into breast milk, but no harmful effects on breastfed babies have been reported. Treating hypothyroidism properly may also help milk supply if it is low. Your dose needs may be different while you are nursing.
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "has no reported harm to", "breastfed babies"]

The relation 'has no reported harm to' in the triplet is defined as 'No adverse effects have been reported in the specified population or condition exposed to the subject drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
